title: Amend availability target to best effort on the home PC
decision: Stay on the maintainer's home PC for the beta and the first public release; adopt no formal availability target; publish measured availability; keep 99.9 percent as the target for a future dedicated host
context: The owner chose home hosting; a home PC cannot honestly promise 99.9 percent
rationale: Honest commitment aligned with the actual host; no extra hosting cost now
